lesson:prompt.capital_of__note: Question prompt. {country} is a localised country name from the content pack.
lesson:feedback.correct.title: Perfect!
lesson:feedback.correct.title__note: Celebration headline after a correct answer. One word, one exclamation mark maximum.
lesson:feedback.wrong.title: That's {chosen}.
lesson:feedback.wrong.title__note: NEVER 'Wrong!' or 'Oops!'. State the truth plainly — no exclamation mark, no sad emoji. See docs/design/voice-and-tone.md.
lesson:feedback.wrong.body__note: Names the right answer and gives one memorable hook. e.g. 'Japan is the island chain to the northeast.'
lesson:answer.label: {country}
lesson:answer.label__note: Accessibility label for an answer option button.
lesson:leave.confirm: Leave lesson? Your progress is saved.
lesson:summary.title: Nice work.
lesson:hearts.empty.title: Out of hearts
lesson:hearts.empty.body: Hearts come back over time. Practice mode is always free.
lesson:hearts.empty.body__note: Critical: must make clear that learning is NEVER blocked.
